body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Haier introduced its first line of digital camcorder 'DV-E58' at CES 2010, featuring 5× Optical zoom and 4× Digital zoom.

The video quality of the 1080p HD camcorder with added features like video stabilization reduces camera shake and will make videos look and sound professionally done. Touch screen controls make it easy to use. Suggested price (MSRP) is $189.99.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
